rule: Four 2026 matches, picked by a rule written on Nov 4 before any per-match death result was looked at. Eligible: matches where both innings reached over 16. Gain = XGBoost's mean death-ball log-loss minus B1's, over both innings. Picked in this order, each from the matches not yet picked: XGBoost's best (most negative gain); XGBoost's worst (most positive gain); typical (gain closest to the median of all eligible matches); close chase (a chase that reached the 20th over, with the smallest gap between the two innings totals; ties go to the earlier match).
